question: when the shadow of a pole of 10 m height is 10√3 m, angular elevation of the Sun is:
solution:
**Given:**

The shadow of a pole of 10 m height = 10√3 m

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1116f95158026d451dcf4b5a24072b1f173c8de4e56a0f6d21cd0998d6fe4df.png] 

Let the angular elevation of sun = θ 

tanθ = Perpendicular/Base

⇒ tanθ = 10/10√3

⇒ tanθ = 1/√3

⇒ tanθ = tan 30° 

⇒ θ = 30° 

**∴ The angular elevation of the sun is 30° **
